name: India–Pakistan
summary: India–Pakistan airspace bans remain; no military strikes since 2025
state: India and Pakistan keep reciprocal bans on each other's aircraft and relations remain frozen since the May 2025 crisis (CFR Global Conflict Tracker). Searches on 6 Nov found no new cross-border strike, mobilisation or Line of Control clash.
for_you: Flights between Europe and South Asia may take longer routes while airspace bans last.
rubric_hit: Treaty suspensions and frozen relations = Watch; no strikes

sources.title: CFR — Conflict between India and Pakistan

why: Two nuclear-armed neighbours with a history of rapid escalation after terrorist attacks.
drivers: Kashmir attacks, Line of Control firing, water disputes (Indus), domestic politics.

rubric.watch: Ceasefire violations, a major terrorist attack with blame assigned, or treaty suspensions.
rubric.normal: Ceasefire holding along the Line of Control; no major attacks.
